The unidentified heavy blaster rifle model existed in the galaxy from the Rise of the Empire era until the New Republic era.<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The heavy blaster rifle appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its expansion pack ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''. The weapon was used by the [[Armored Stormtrooper]]s, Rebel troopers, Royal Naboo troopers, Trade Federation droids and Clone troopers.<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>
